stories.title: Watching Roku’s AI channel is like eating from a trough
stories.simple_summary: Roku is creating a TV channel that shows only computer-generated movies and shows instead of real programs made by people. It's free to watch but has advertisements.
stories.why_it_matters: This doesn't affect you unless you use Roku — and if you do, you now have the option to watch AI content, but plenty of regular shows are still available.

stories.title: OpenAI puts the brakes on a new model because it’s supposedly too powerful
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI stopped work on a new AI tool called Astra because they're worried it might be unsafe or too powerful before they add better security protections. Other AI companies admitted their programs also caused unexpected problems.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a sign that AI companies are being more careful about safety, which is good — but this mostly matters to tech companies and investors.

stories.title: What’s behind the Google AI shake-up
stories.simple_summary: Several important people who work on AI at Google, including a famous engineer named Jeff Dean, changed jobs or left Google this week.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors watching Google — it doesn't affect how you use Google's services today.

stories.title: Cloudflare launches Kitesurf, a browser built for AI agents
stories.simple_summary: A company called Cloudflare created a special web browser designed for AI programs to use instead of people, which runs more efficiently.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mainly for programmers and tech companies building AI systems — nothing you need to know about as a regular person.

stories.title: How AI Is Making Cybersecurity A Critical Tech Battlefield
stories.simple_summary: AI is making cybersecurity (protecting computers from hackers) more important and competitive.
stories.why_it_matters: Your business should keep paying attention to protecting your computers and passwords, as hackers are using more advanced tools.

stories.title: Airbnb says AI is helping it ship features faster as it tests a new search function
stories.simple_summary: Airbnb is using AI to build new features faster, including a new way to search for rentals on their website.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use Airbnb, you may soon see a search tool that works a bit differently — but it's designed to make finding rentals easier.

stories.title: Doximity Stock Soars 55% After Earnings Miss. Its AI Can Beat Anthropic.
stories.simple_summary: A medical company's stock price went up 55% after they reported earnings, partly because their AI software performs well.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: Jill Lepore on the ‘Artificial State’ and why Silicon Valley’s leaders are bad sci-fi readers
stories.simple_summary: A historian named Jill Lepore thinks tech companies use fancy language and big promises in a way that doesn't always match reality.
stories.why_it_matters: This is interesting criticism about how tech companies talk, but it doesn't directly affect your daily use of technology.

stories.title: New Mexico court orders Meta to pay additional $567M in child safety case
stories.simple_summary: Meta (which owns Facebook and Instagram) was ordered by a court in New Mexico to pay an additional $567 million for not protecting children safely on their platforms.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use Meta's apps, this shows the company is facing real consequences for safety problems — but it doesn't change how the apps work for you.

stories.title: Who is liable when AI goes rogue? Lawyers see new risks
stories.simple_summary: Lawyers are discussing who should be held responsible when an AI system makes a mistake or causes harm.
stories.why_it_matters: This is important for how laws will work in the future, but right now these legal rules are still being figured out.

stories.title: As Colorado universities align with ChatGPT, student AI resisters take a stand against the ‘plagiarism machine’
stories.simple_summary: Some Colorado college students are refusing to use ChatGPT because they believe it's like cheating or plagiarism, even though their universities are accepting it.
stories.why_it_matters: This doesn't affect you unless you're in college — but it shows there's real disagreement about whether AI tools should be allowed in school.

stories.title: Artificial intelligence in drug discovery — what it is, where we stand and the path forward
stories.simple_summary: Scientists are learning how to use artificial intelligence to help discover new medicines faster.
stories.why_it_matters: In the future, this could mean new drugs get developed more quickly — but this is still early research and won't affect you right now.
